name: Do I need a permit for a small bathroom remodel in San Diego or Chula Vista?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a small bathroom remodel in San Diego or Chula Vista?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Whether a permit is needed depends on the work and the jurisdiction. In the City of San Diego, official guidance says a bathroom remodel without structural, wall-framing, or exterior-wall changes and without added plumbing fixtures may qualify for a no-plan permit, while some like-for-like replacements may be exempt; applicable codes still apply.

Other cities in San Diego County can have different procedures, and historic properties or districts may receive additional review. Elite Remodeling & Design includes permit coordination within its published design-build process when the project requires it.

Key factors:
- Fixture locations and added fixtures
- Structural or framing changes
- Plumbing and electrical alterations
- Historic-district status

Give the project address, scope, and property history at the consultation. Confirm in writing who prepares applications, schedules inspections, and handles corrections before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: It depends on the scope and city. San Diego guidance allows some same-layout bathroom work to use a no-plan permit and exempts certain limited replacements, but plumbing, electrical, structural, added-fixture, historic-property, and other work may require review. Confirm requirements for the specific address.
